calls.video_title: He Called the 1987 Crash. Now He’s Calling This
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated for MarketBeat (guest Dr Mark Skousen; was BUY in an earlier MarketBeat video, no flip) — Southern Copper is one of two copper names he calls 'great companies': 'if you want something a little more conservative, I think going into the copper stocks is the way to go.' No share price stated; copper itself is at an all-time high approaching $7 a pound (stated).
calls.base_case: Copper demand is being driven by data centres and by an ageing national infrastructure that has to be rebuilt, including chips and electrical build-out.
calls.bull_case: Supply is strained: very few new copper mines exist, so higher demand meets limited supply — he thinks copper prices can keep rising well beyond current levels.
calls.bear_case: A strong dollar (if interest rates keep rising) hurts the mining industry generally; metal prices are volatile and other guests have warned copper may not be near a top — or may be extended after a wild run.

calls.video_title: Dan Ferris: Copper Could Double—and He Says You Have to Own It | SIH
calls.thesis: Largest proven copper reserves in the world — "a good conservative bet" for longer-horizon commodity exposure in a retirement-style portfolio.
calls.bull: Reserve leverage means copper price gains flow straight through without new capex.
calls.bear: Small-cap explorers offer more upside but he advises against them for most investors.
